full_name: Tania Bruguera | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Arts Elizabeth S. and Richard M. Cashin Fellow New York City Mayor’s Office of Immigrant Affairs
bio: The installation and performance artist Tania Bruguera researches ways in which art can be applied to everyday political life, focusing on the transformation of social affect into political effectiveness. Her long-term projects have been intensive interventions on the institutional structure of collective memory, education, and politics.
